title: Reviewing Zone Types

children:
A zone type indicates the general function of zone(s) in your warehouse. 
 You can review the system-created zone types on the Zone Type Window. 
 If your require additional zone types, you may create them on the Zone 
 Type Window.

Locating Zones group together 
 locations that share the same locating requirements.

Allocation Zones group 
 together locations that share the same allocating requirements.

Work Zones group together 
 locations serviced by the same work teams and equipment types. In addition, 
 the same work types are performed in a work zone.
